ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Mars

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.
